targetText: In this way arose feudal Socialism: half lamentation, half lampoon;
summary: Feudal aristocrats criticized capitalist greed not to help workers, but to regain their lost medieval privileges.
context: Marx exposes how displaced aristocrats tried to trick workers into supporting feudal restoration.

summary: Small business owners criticize big corporations, wanting to turn back the clock to pre-industrial craftsmanship.
context: Marx argues that returning to small-scale pre-industrial work is an impossible fantasy.
